summary: Tested New Coach Signup Flow. Backend: 18/20 tests passed (90%). Frontend: Coach signup 3-step flow works, Join Team page works, but Coach Home dashboard fails due to /api/users/me returning 500 for coach users.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error for coach users. The User Pydantic model requires 'username' and 'age' fields which coach accounts don't have (coaches have 'name' instead of 'username' and no 'age' field).
critical.root_cause: User model at line 202-216 in server.py doesn't include coach-specific fields and requires fields that coaches don't have

minor.issue: User model doesn't include 'team_id' and 'joined_via_coach' fields for players who joined via coach team link

ui_bugs.issue: Page title shows 'Join Join Test Team' - duplicate 'Join' word

integration_issues.issue: Coach cannot access /coach-home because /api/users/me fails with 500, causing AuthContext to logout the user

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix User model in server.py to support coach accounts - either create a separate CoachUser model or make username/age optional with defaults
Add 'team_id' and 'joined_via_coach' fields to User model for players who joined via coach link
Fix JoinTeam.js title to not duplicate 'Join' word
critical_code_review_comments: User model (line 202-216) requires 'username' and 'age' which coach accounts don't have - causes /api/users/me to fail for coaches
Token storage inconsistency: AuthContext uses 'forge_token' but CoachSignup.js and JoinTeam.js were using 'token' - FIXED by testing agent
Coach-home route was missing requiresOnboarding={false} - FIXED by testing agent

success_rate.frontend: Partial - Coach signup flow works, Coach Home dashboard blocked by backend bug

seed_data_creation: Multiple test coaches and players created during testing with unique UUIDs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Coach signup flow backend APIs all work correctly. rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The User Pydantic model at line 202-216 in server.py requires 'username: str' and 'age: int' fields. Coach accounts are created with 'name' instead of 'username' and no 'age' field. When /api/users/me tries to return User(**current_user) for a coach, Pydantic validation fails causing 500 error.
reproduction_steps: 2. Try to access /api/users/me with coach token
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation: Update User model to make username and age optional with defaults, or create a separate endpoint/model for coach users
